Substitution Requests

Substitution requests can be submitted using your Odd Bunch email address on the form below.

Pantry Box substitutions can be made by logging in to your account.

One substitution from the same box is absolutely free. Additional substitutions will be $0.99 each. If you wish to make two or more substitutions, please resubmit the form.


All requests must be submitted between 2:00pm local time (after the menu for the week has been updated) on Monday to 11:55pm Eastern Time on Tuesday.


Please note that some items may not be available to add as replacements due to limited inventory.


If you have any questions, you can contact our team at help@oddbunch.ca.
